CustomField.description: The canonical answer this row was reconciled into. Set at promotion when a person gains a Contact and a Contact-keyed answer for the same person and contract already stands. The superseded row keeps every claim, citation and verdict it was written with; it stops projecting and stops counting, and the canonical row replays through it. Nothing is deleted and no claim is ever edited - the org refuses that, and its refusal is why the merge happens at read time.
